dish.title: Nigerian Beef Suya Skewers with Tomato-Onion Salad and Rice

recipe_version.title: Nigerian Beef Suya Skewers with Tomato-Onion Salad and Rice
recipe_version.description: Thin strips of beef coated in yaji, a smoky, spicy ground-peanut spice blend with ginger, garlic, paprika, and cayenne, grilled hot on skewers and served with sliced tomato, red onion, cabbage, lime, and steamed jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: beef sirloin steak
ingredients.preparation: sliced 1/4 inch thick against the grain

steps.title: Make yaji and prep
steps.body: Grind the peanuts in a spice grinder or mini processor to a coarse powder (pulse; stop before it turns to butter). Mix with the ginger, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, and 1 tsp salt. Toss the beef with the oil and 3/4 of the yaji and thread onto 8 metal skewers. Slice the tomatoes and onion, shred the cabbage, and cut the lime.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear. Bring it to a boil with the 2.25 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt in the saucepan, cover, simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest off heat 10 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.body: While the rice simmers, preheat the grill or grill pan to high for 10 minutes and oil the grates (overlap stated).

steps.title: Grill the suya
steps.body: Grill the skewers over high heat, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked to at least medium, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Sprinkle with the remaining yaji.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the skewers over the rice with the tomato, onion, cabbage, and lime wedges.

equipment: spice grinder or mini food processor
